sourceFile: 29-1. BRS-201506 Report test DOE Forming sub VP- date 14.3.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable rows but misidentifies the changed factor and misgroups baseline/test outcomes.
issues: Changed factor omits actual temperature settings and extra 210-230C test condition.
Change domain labels are unsupported by source context.
Function comparisons reuse one normal row across different dates instead of matched date rounds.
VP-line NG-rate results are left as invalid measurement summaries, not judged comparisons.
Many measurement stats cite only header rows and are not reliable evidence.
correctionPlan: Define changed factor as VP forming/cooling temperature condition versus normal, preserving each temperature set.
Treat 170-190C/90-110C and 210-230C/30-50C as separate test conditions where supported.
Regroup DOE FM results by section and date/test round before judging NG rates.
Replace header-only measurement summaries with row-backed SPL, THD, IMP, FO comparisons.
Remove unsupported domains and redundant or non-evidentiary rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but citation granularity and grouping are insufficient for final evidence.
